title: Abashyitsi badasanzwe b'Umujyi Ukikijwe n'Inkuta
intro: Itsinda ry’abantu ryageze ku marembo y’umujyi abaturage bawo batari barigeze bamenya ukuri. Bazanye ubutumwa, ariko abaturage bahinduka abanzi, batera ubwoba. Nyamara, baturutse ahantu hatunguranye, ijwi rimwe ryarahagurutse rirengera abo batazi, ritegura ihinduka rikomeye ry’ibintu.
clues: Twinjiye mu mujyi abantu bawo bari barembejwe no kutizera.
Baratureba bafite amakenga maze baravuga bati 'Muri ibiremwa bisanzwe nkatwe.'
Umugabo yaturutse mu mpera z'umujyi yihuta cyane kugira ngo yemeze ukuri kwacu.
Yabwiye abantu be ati 'Kuki ntagomba gusenga uwandemye?'
Ukwanga kw'umujyi kwarangiye habayeho urusaku rumwe, maze haguma ituze aho bajyaga baseka.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Ikizamini cyo kwihangana ku mwana wabuze

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Umujyi warasenyutse kubera induru imwe gusa
Inyanja yaracitsemo kabiri maze irarohama ingabo
Umuriro wabaye nk'ukonje kandi nta kibazo
Ubusitani bwatwitswe n'umuriro wo mu ijuru
Ifi nini yasubije umuntu ku nkombe
outcome.answer: Umujyi warasenyutse kubera induru imwe gusa

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
